title: Five-Word Joint BiGAN 4k Retention Hold (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `five_word_joint_hold` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Continues the candidate's earliest passing `five_word_joint_smoke` checkpoint for 4,000 updates, requiring every single scheduled generation and inverse-reconstruction check to stay passing without drift.
failure_mode: Even after clean acquisition, coupled BiGAN minimax dynamics gradually rotate or collapse latent word codes, causing late-window reconstruction drop or mode loss.
protocol_notes: Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `five_word_joint_hold` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.
